description: QueryDef parameter round trip, integer types (own copy of r-wire-blank): for each declared type Byte, Short, Long, a temporary QueryDef PARAMETERS pV type; SELECT pV AS V FROM One; Parameter Type and Value read, then for each value (UI1 0 and 255, I2 -1 and 256, I4 65536, max, min, R8 1.5 and 2.5, BSTR "7" and "abc", Null, Empty, Boolean True) Parameters("pV").Value = Arg, Value read back, OpenRecordset(snapshot) and the V field read. Asks what the Parameter returns and what the engine returns, with tags.

args.text: PARAMETERS pV Byte; SELECT pV AS V FROM One;
PARAMETERS pV Short; SELECT pV AS V FROM One;
PARAMETERS pV Long; SELECT pV AS V FROM One;
